subject: PT revalidation & formal verification request — MedSecure Health
messages:
From: Lena Ortega <lena.ortega@medsecurehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medsecurehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the remediation summary you shared last week. Our security team did a quick review and we'd like Redwood to provide a formal post-remediation validation so we can close the risk items on our side. Specifically we need:

- A re-test report (delta-focused) that verifies the previously identified findings are no longer exploitable.
- A brief verification letter on Redwood letterhead that states the retest scope, dates, and that the referenced findings were validated as remediated.
- Any supporting evidence (patch IDs, configs, screenshots) to tie fixes to the CVEs.

The key items we need covered are the two critical findings from the October 2026 engagement (referenced as CVE-2026-3456 and CVE-2026-1122) and the auth/session handling endpoint (/api/v1/auth). We are flexible on whether Redwood runs the re-test with your vendor or if you can provide a third-party retest attestation.

Can you confirm timeline and expected artifacts? Procurement is copied to coordinate any PO or SOW changes.

Best,
Lena Ortega
Senior InfoSec Manager | MedSecure Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortega <lena.ortega@medsecurehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@medsecurehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask and the CVE references. We can support this in one of two ways: 1) coordinate a formal re-test with our external pen test partner and provide the third-party delta report plus a Redwood verification letter, or 2) provide an internal revalidation memo plus remediation evidence if you accept internal verification. Given you requested a third-party verification, we will engage SecureAudit (our vendor) to perform the constrained re-test.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in SecureAudit and share the sanitized test credentials and exact scope for the re-test (production-sim environment only).
- SecureAudit will provide a delta re-test report and a verification letter signed by their team; Redwood will also produce a short attestation that ties the fixes to our change-ids.
- Target timeline: vendor kickoff this week, test window 5 business days, draft delta report within 3 business days after testing.

I’ve copied Vivek and Diego from our security/infra teams to coordinate scope, and Procurement on your side for any SOW adjustments. Attached is our remediation summary workbook for reference (redwood-remediation-summary.xlsx).

If that plan works I’ll request availability from SecureAudit and confirm next steps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@secureaudit.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter

Kimberly — thanks for the intro. SecureAudit can perform a focused re-test of the previously failed items. A few clarifying requests before we lock dates:

1) Confirm exact scope endpoints and IP range (production-sim hostnames only). Please confirm whether /api/v1/auth and the associated session store (redis cluster) are in scope.
2) Provide short-lived test accounts (non-admin) and any pre-seeded test data. We need accounts that simulate normal user flows to validate the auth/session fixes.
3) Confirm whether you want only validation of the two CVEs or a light smoke test of other high findings. Changes to scope affect cost and timing.

We can run the retest during May 13-17 and will deliver a delta report and verification letter addressed to MedSecure Health. Standard delta re-test engagement fee is attached in the engagement-order-12345.pdf. Once scope is confirmed and credentials are provided we’ll send a kickoff calendar and the SOW.

Example output:
- Delta report (concise, showing each previously failing finding status: verified fixed / not fully addressed / regression)
- Verification letter on SecureAudit letterhead (signed PDF)
- Short remediation mapping (ticket IDs and evidence references)

Let me know if you want a kickoff call tomorrow.

Regards,
Ashwin Rao
Director, Assessments | SecureAudit LLC
Attachment: engagement-order-12345.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@secureaudit.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter

Ashwin — thanks for the quick reply. Scope clarification below (we want the re-test to be constrained and non-destructive):

Scope (production-sim environment):
- Hostnames: app-staging-1.redwood-inference.internal (reachable via VPN tunnel provided below)
- Endpoints: /api/v1/auth, /api/v1/session, /api/v1/oauth/callback (full auth flow)
- IPs: 10.14.23.0/24 (test network only)
- Data stores in-scope: redis-session-01 (read-only, snapshot provided)

Important notes:
- Do NOT run destructive tests (DB writes/DDL). This is strictly verification of authentication/session handling and associated CVE mitigations.
- We will provide short-lived test creds via the secure Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MedSecure/pt_retest_credentials.txt). Expiry: 72 hours after issuance.
- Fixed items and mapping: CVE-2026-3456 -> CHG-4589 (deployed 2027-04-27), CVE-2026-1122 -> CHG-4621 (deployed 2027-04-30). Evidence bundle attached (remediation-evidence.zip).

We are prepared to support the May 13-17 window. Please confirm the kickoff time and any additional IAM tokens you require.

Vivek
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference
From: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@secureaudit.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter

Thanks Vivek — that scope is clear and acceptable. We’ll proceed with May 13 kickoff. Proposed schedule:
- May 13: Kickoff call (30min) & initial smoke validation
- May 14-15: Focused testing (auth/session flows)
- May 16: Internal QA and report drafting
- May 17: Deliverables to Redwood and MedSecure (delta report + verification letter)

We’ll prepare the verification letter on our letterhead and include a short signed attestation for MedSecure which explicitly references CHG-4589 and CHG-4621. SOW/PO notes: we received a PO from MedSecure for the retest (PO# MS-2027-079). Please confirm invoice contact and any billing remarks. Statement_of_Work_retest.pdf attached.

See you on the kickoff — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Ashwin
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortega <lena.ortega@medsecurehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@medsecurehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ashwin Rao <ashwin@secureaudit.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for PT re-test validation + verification letter — confirmation and expected artifacts

Hi Lena / Procurement,

Quick update to confirm coordination is complete and SecureAudit will run the constrained retest May 13-17. After completion you should expect the following deliverables from our combined effort:

- SecureAudit delta re-test report (concise): status for each previously failing finding (verified fixed / needs follow-up).
- SecureAudit verification letter (signed PDF) addressed to MedSecure Health.
- Redwood attestation memo mapping our change requests (CHG-4589, CHG-4621) to the fixes and linking to remediation evidence.
- Evidence bundle (screenshots, patch IDs, config diffs) for audit purposes.

Acceptance criteria: Verified fixed = end-to-end exploit attempts fail under the scope described and SecureAudit marks the finding as remediated in their delta report. Please confirm whether you also require a SOC 2 control crosswalk for these items — we can provide a short mapping if needed.

If that looks good please reply with a single-line acceptance so we can proceed to finalize the kickoff invite and ensure billing contact is set.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
